race.comment: ENCHILADA (11) comes here off a solid debut at Seymour when in the market against stronger opposition, working home fairly to be beaten 4.5 lengths. He'll come on from that and is suited up in trip against relatively well-exposed opposition. ALL MOONLITE (7) has had two runs back this time in and been solid, beaten under three lengths over this route last time out. The fresh run was good as well and she should go close. HEIDI HIGH (8) resumes having raced once to date, sent out favourite at Penola but struggling. Watch the betting on home track. PITMAN (4) was okay fresh at Hamilton and should be fitter from a good draw. ENDLESS FURY (12) has upside and is in the mix.
